notes: The Hebrew gloss note An overthrow, overthrow, overthrow, will I make it explains the noun triplet; the ASV's verbal recasting is what is aligned.

אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ correctly fuses to *whose* under rule 30, and the head of the אֲשִׂימֶנָּה unit falls on *will* because the verb's own lexeme is unrendered, with the competing reading named in that unit's note.

One note could be fuller: the `right it is` unit on מִשְׁפָּט rests on rule 20's sole-overt-anchor reading, but a defensible competing reading hands the construction-supplied *it is* to the fused whose unit under rule 30's clause about a unit additionally carrying a copula. The unit assignment itself is sound; only the rule 8 hedge is thin, which does not warrant reissuing the array.
